ordinary_dag.lane_k: 256*t+8*lane+j when K%8==0; increasing t; skip the entire eight-element vector unless i+8<=K
ordinary_dag.widen: u16 << 16, implemented packed-low shift / packed-high mask 0xffff0000
ordinary_dag.chain: a[j%4] = fma(X_j, W_j, a[j%4]); j=0..7 increasing; no group dot or extra group add
ordinary_dag.scalar_domain: When K%8!=0, all K uses k=lane+32*t and only a0=fma(X_k,W_k,a0). This is not a tail appended to the vector domain.
ordinary_dag.fold: Actual x4 object operand order: b23=a3+a2 (0x1add8); b01=a1+a0 (0x1aef4); sum=b23+b01 (0x1af04). This is the source tree (a0+a1)+(a2+a3) with emitted commutations preserved, including NaN source order.
ordinary_dag.reduction: snapshot own+other at 16 (ds_swizzle BITMASK_PERM 1pppp), then 8/4/2/1 (ds_bpermute); out-of-range source selects own lane; only lane0 stored
ordinary_dag.load_unroll: The decode helper prefetches eight vectors; the wide schedule removes this load-only unroll without changing any chain's arithmetic subsequence.

hc_k4_dag.quarters: Four wave32 partitions of contiguous K/4 elements per output; each quarter runs the same row DAG at local K=K/4.
hc_k4_dag.quarter_fold: s_add_f32 q0,q1 at 0xbe88; s_add_f32 q2,q3 at 0xbe8c; s_add_f32 first,second at 0xbe94. Scalar operations are retained, not replaced by VALU.
hc_k4_dag.activation: BF16 round trip; s_mul_f32(scale,value); BF16 round trip; value/(1+expf(-value)); BF16 round trip. hc_act=0 stores the unactivated quarter fold.
hc_k4_dag.bf16_round: Finite bits: (u32(value)+0x7fff+((u32(value)>>16)&1)) & 0xffff0000. Exp255: preserve original high16, set bit16 iff low16!=0 before masking (hip_bfloat16 NaN/Inf branch).
hc_k4_dag.exp: 0xbfa0..0xc010: scalar multiply by 0xbfb8aa3b, negative-product XOR, s_rndne_f32, compensated s_fmamk_f32 with 0xbfb8aa3b and 0xb2a5705f, s_sub_f32 and s_add_f32, v_exp_f32 and v_ldexp_f32; exact comparisons/clamps against 0x42ce8ed0 and 0xc2b17218.
hc_k4_dag.divide: 0xc01c..0xc07c: add(1,exp), v_div_scale_f32 denominator, v_rcp_f32, residual/refinement FMA, v_div_scale_f32 numerator with VCC output, product+residual refinements, v_div_fmas_f32, v_div_fixup_f32; no approximate reciprocal-only substitution.
hc_k4_dag.encoder_coverage: Native assembly calls peacemaker_lift::text::parse_line and peacemaker_ir gfx11::encode (peacemaker-isa/src/native/mod.rs:50-55). Scalar arithmetic entries are in peacemaker-ir/isa/gfx1151.tbl; v_div_fixup/fmas/scale entries are in gfx1100.tbl inherited by gfx1151. Initial inspection limited to src/native was insufficient; there is no missing epilogue opcode in the full table inventory.
hc_k4_dag.builder_gate: Arch::check_mnemonic previously rejected s_add_f32 and s_mul_f32 on gfx1151 despite the real gfx1151 table entries. This module corrects that gate for gfx1151 only; gfx1100 still rejects those two instructions. No arithmetic encoder shortcut was added.
hc_k4_dag.text_parser: The scalar s_fmamk_f32/s_fmaak_f32 text front end omitted the mandatory literal syntax even though the codec/table already encoded it. parse.rs/print.rs now preserve the four-operand literal slot; pinned BF16 decode words A3040400 BFB8AA3B are covered by regression tests. No codec change. Native BF16 emission passes; all44 re-emittable existing images remain byte-identical (identity.json).
hc_k4_dag.implementation_decision: PM-primary on gfx1151 when hardware byte gates admit it, preserving extracted scalar and vector FP instruction DAG; HIP twin remains fallback.

evidence_scope: CPU extraction and instruction/descriptor inspection only. These hashes identify the locally compiled reference object; runtime compiler/flags must match or re-extract. No GPU byte, graph replay, occupancy, latency or end-to-end admission result is claimed.
